'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Wagner Group rebellion]]
****[[Wagner Group]] leader [[Yevgeny Prigozhin]] declares that he will "stop" the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] leadership and calls for a "march of justice", claiming that his forces have been killed in [[airstrike]]s by Russian government forces. The [[Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation|defence ministry]] rejects the claims, stating that they are "not true and are an information provocation". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-66005256 (BBC News)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/mutiny-wagern-prigozhin-1.6887226 (CBC News)] [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/06/23/prigozhin-says-moscow-strikes-kill-huge-number-of-wagner-forces-vows-to-stop-top-brass-a81615 (''The Moscow Times'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jun/23/wagner-chief-accuses-russias-military-of-attack-and-says-evil-leadership-must-be-stopped (''The Guardian'')]
****The [[Prosecutor-General of Russia]] [[Igor Krasnov]] formally orders the arrest of Yevgeny Prigozhin on charges of calling for an "armed rebellion", with authorities urging Wagner personnel to refuse Prigozhin's "criminal and treacherous orders" and to detain him. The [[Federal Security Service|FSB]] begins a [[mutiny]] investigation into Yevgeny Prigozhin. [https://tass.com/russia/1637425 (TASS)] [https://tass.com/russia/1637417 (TASS 2)] [https://www.npr.org/2023/06/23/1184090744/russia-wagner-group-yevgeny-prigozhin-criminal-case (NPR)]
****[[BBC News Russian]] reports that there are roadblocks on the [[M4 highway (Russia)|M4 highway]] between [[Moscow]] and [[Voronezh]], with the [[Federal Security Service|FSB]] and other security services being placed on high alert in the [[Moscow Oblast]]. [https://t.me/bbcrussian/48274 (BBC News Russian)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**[[2021–present United Kingdom cost-of-living crisis]]
***[[Chancellor of the Exchequer]] [[Jeremy Hunt]] unveils a "[[Mortgages in English law|mortgage]] charter", which includes a 12-month protection against [[repossession]], to assist property owners with increasing mortgage costs caused by the [[Bank of England]]'s [[interest rate]] hikes. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/uk-launches-mortgage-help-interest-rates-soar-3583486 (CNA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Welkom mining explosion]]
**The [[Government of South Africa|government]] of [[South Africa]] reports that on May 18, at least 31 people were killed in a [[gas explosion]] at an [[illegal mining|illegally operated]] [[mining in South Africa|mining]] shaft in [[Welkom]], [[Free State (province)|Free State]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-miners-dead-gas-illegal-mining-775bbccdb47871caef06b5beb71ef76b (AP)] [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2598243/31-die-in-abandoned-south-african-gold-mine (AFP via ''Bangkok Post'')]
**A [[Cessna 208 Caravan]] crashes with six people on board in Elelim, [[Yalimo Regency]], [[Highland Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. The rescue operations are being impacted by severe weather in the region. [https://seputarpapua.com/view/tim-sar-pastikan-bangkai-pesawat-sam-air-pk-smw-terbakar-usai-menabrak-gunung.html (SeputarPapua)]
*Four people are killed and five others are injured in an [[explosion]] at a [[steel mill]] in [[Yingkou]], [[Liaoning]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-steel-mill-explosion-yingkou-a41b59db52cf050a7d8d54d57c9c5f2e (AP)]
*Eight people are injured after a [[tornado]] hits the [[North Antelope Rochelle Mine]] in [[Campbell County, Wyoming| Campbell County]], [[Wyoming]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/wyoming-tornado-injuries-mine-workers-df483a7c93ff6bec2ece244845372cdf (AP)]
'''International relations'''
*[[Philippines–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**[[President of the United Arab Emirates|UAE President]] [[Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan]] grants [[President of the Philippines|Philippine President]] [[Bongbong Marcos]]' request for the [[humanitarian pardon]] of three imprisoned [[Filipinos in the United Arab Emirates|Filipinos]], two on [[Capital punishment in the United Arab Emirates|death row]] for [[drug trafficking]] and another serving a 15-year [[Sentence (law)|sentence]] for [[slander]]. [https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2023/6/24/uae-pardons-three-filipino-convicts.html (CNN Philippines)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[Canada Border Services Agency]] (CBSA) prosecutes an [[Indian citizen]], in accordance with the ''[[Immigration and Refugee Protection Act]]'', for allegedly issuing [[Scam letters|fraudulent]] [[University and college admission|university acceptance]] letters to [[Indian students abroad|Indian students]]. The CBSA has suspended some of the affected students' [[deportation]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/canada-authorities-charge-indian-man-immigration-fraud-targeting-students-3584061 (CNA)]
